---
description: Review all AGENTS.md files and update them to match the latest code changes
agent: ask
---

Review all `AGENTS.md` files in the project and ensure they are accurate and consistent with the current codebase.

Tasks:
- Compare each `AGENTS.md` against the corresponding source files it documents.
- Update descriptions, responsibilities, and data flows if the implementation has changed.
- Ensure type names, class names, and function names are precise and not generic placeholders.
- Align the structure of all files to the agreed format:
  - Purpose
  - Overview
  - Data Flow (if applicable)
  - Design Principles
  - Agent Guidelines
  - Do / Don’t
- Normalize status wording using this convention:
  - ✅ Implemented — stable and tested
  - 🟡 Partial — implemented, but incomplete (explain what’s missing)
  - ⚠️ Minimal — very limited coverage (clarify scope)
  - 🚧 Placeholder — not implemented yet
- Add cross-references where useful between related documentation files.
- Remove outdated references (e.g., planned features that are now implemented).
- Do not rewrite AGENTS.md files from scratch; only update what is inconsistent or outdated.
